meta.title: Xiaohongshu Reply Style
meta.description: Runs 2–3 rounds of requirements discovery before product selection, version choice, or competitive analysis: validate real pain points and hard constraints, reassess original and alternative routes, then research only after confirmation, with an explicit user skip. Confirmed reports use the Xiaohongshu-style structure, concrete steps, audited images and sources, and a banned-slang filter. Ordinary lookups, code, and formal documents are exempt.
